tool_signatures.name: S3Controller_deleteFile
tool_signatures.description: Deletes the object (and its thumbnail) at the given S3 key. If `ownerType` and `ownerId` are provided, the named row is excluded from the reference-count check so its own surviving `imageUrl` does not block the delete; the file is kept only when another row still references it. When the owner params are omitted, the file is deleted unconditionally.

path.description: S3 key of the file to delete (e.g. `article/{listId}/{id}`).

ownerType.description: Entity kind that owns this image and is clearing its reference. Must be provided together with `ownerId`.

ownerId.description: Primary key of the owning row (uuid for `list_item` / `article_catalog`, barcode value for `barcode`). Must be provided together with `ownerType`.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Primary key of the owning row (uuid for `list_item` / `article_catalog`, barcode value for `barcode`). Must be provided together with `ownerType`.

parameters.description: Entity kind that owns this image and is clearing its reference. Must be provided together with `ownerId`.
